# Phase 07 — Blender upstream source audit + genuine embedded file regression

Date: 2026-11-02. Sources: eight archives supplied by the user. Only narrow structure/layout knowledge was used; no GPL Blender implementation files were copied into the codec.

## Source archives inspected

| Supplied archive | Relevant source locations | Historical observations |
|---|---|---|
| blender-2.28a.tar.gz | `source/blender/makesdna/DNA_mesh_types.h`, `DNA_curve_types.h`, `DNA_action_types.h`; `source/blender/blenloader/intern/readfile.c` | `MFace.v1..v4` are `ushort` (2 bytes); `TFace.uv[4][2]`; Action uses `bActionChannel.ipo`; `IpoCurve` is defined in `DNA_curve_types.h` |
| blender-2.58.tgz | `DNA_mesh_types.h`, `DNA_anim_types.h`, `readfile.c` | `MFace`/`MVert` remain alongside FCurves/Actions; historical compatibility fields exist |
| blender-2.79a.tar.gz | `DNA_meshdata_types.h`, `DNA_mesh_types.h` | `MFace.v1..v4` are `unsigned int` (4 bytes); `MPoly` and `MLoop` represent polygons/corners |
| blender-2.90.1.tar.xz | `DNA_mesh_types.h`, `DNA_customdata_types.h` | Legacy mesh topology and CustomData paths coexist |
| blender-3.6.3.tar.xz | `DNA_mesh_types.h` | `Mesh.totpoly`, `Mesh.totloop`, `Mesh.poly_offset_indices`, `vdata/edata/pdata/ldata` |
| blender-4.5.14.tar.xz | `DNA_mesh_types.h`, `DNA_action_types.h` | `Mesh.faces_num`, `Mesh.corners_num`, `Mesh.face_offset_indices`, `vert_data` etc.; layered Action layout |
| blender-main.zip | `DNA_attribute_types.h`, `DNA_mesh_types.h`, `DNA_action_types.h` | Main-branch AttributeStorage and Action structures; do not assume its version is identical to any tagged release |
| blender-main (1).zip | Same paths | Same tested DNA/mesh/animation files as the other main ZIP. Only 3 non-DNA Python UI files have different CRC/length among 20,935 regular files. |

**Important:** The source *archive version* and the saved *internal .blend version* may differ. The 2.28a archive includes .blend files saved with 2.01 and 2.02; the 4.5.14 archive includes startup saved by 3.06 and preview saved by 4.03.

## Concrete changes in this phase

1. `src/bc_mesh_legacy.c`: read 2-byte or 4-byte `MFace` vertex indices using field type length from the file's own SDNA, including endian-aware 16-bit access. The previous hard-coded 4-byte read rejected 2.28a-style faces.
2. `src/bc_mesh_legacy.c` and `src/bc_mesh_modern.c`: support both `totpoly`/`poly_offset_indices`/`totloop` (3.6) and `faces_num`/`face_offset_indices`/`corners_num` (newer Blender) when extracting modern corner topology.
3. `src/bc_uv_tface.c`: independent historical `Mesh.tface -> TFace.uv[4][2]` vendor. Export 4 vt entries per historical MFace; triangles reference 3 and ignore the fourth. This is *not* the `MLoopUV` path.
4. Added source-informed synthetic regressions for 2.28a 16-bit face indices, 3.6 offset-indexed polygons, and 2.28a TFace UVs. Added an optional automated test for seven genuine `.blend` files from the uploaded source archives.

## Real-world corpus discovered

The following are *authentic .blend files already bundled with the supplied source tarballs*, not files generated by our fixture builders. The native source archives are NOT redistributed in the Phase07 ZIP.

| Source tarball | Embedded file | Internal BLEND version | Extracted OBJ: vertices | faces | UV tuples |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2.58 | `release/datafiles/preview.blend` | 250 | 2446 | 2310 | 0 |
| 2.58 | `source/gameengine/GamePlayer/common/load.blend` | 241 | 4 | 1 | 4 |
| 2.79a | `release/datafiles/startup.blend` | 272 | 8 | 6 | 0 |
| 2.79a | `release/datafiles/preview.blend` | 262 | 1345 | 1914 | 6344 |
| 2.90.1 | `release/datafiles/startup.blend` | 280 | 8 | 6 | 24 |
| 3.6.3 | `release/datafiles/startup.blend` | 306 | 8 | 6 | 24 |
| 4.5.14 | `release/datafiles/preview_grease_pencil.blend` | 403 | 211 | 121 | 484 |

Each of these seven files completed `--info` and `--obj` successfully in the current Linux test environment. This confirms format reading and OBJ export for these assets, not Blender-equivalent evaluated scene rendering. No guarantee that all UVs, modifiers, materials, collections, rigs, or actions in each file were reconstructed; this test concerns geometric export.

## Known failures / unverified

- The six uncompressed `.blend` examples examined in the 2.28a archive are internally 2.01/2.02, and this parser's block scan reports errors. The very old serialization needs separate analysis; do not report 2.28a genuine format compatibility from the synthetic test.
- Most 4.5.14 brush files are Zstandard-wrapped; other embedded samples are Gzip-wrapped. In-project Gzip/Zstandard decode is not yet implemented. External decompression is still needed.
- The `blender-main` ZIPs contain many *Git LFS pointer text files* with `.blend` names (~130 bytes) rather than genuine embedded BLEND files; they are not useful as test binary fixtures without separately obtaining their LFS objects.
- Files with no mesh block correctly do not produce an OBJ; `--meshes` returning unsupported does not mean the BLEND header or SDNA failed.
- Blender 4.5 native saved meshes, Blender 5.x native saved meshes, and large-header actual samples remain **unverified** by this corpus.
- No real-file visual validation against Blender, no complete evaluated animation/IK/NLA or B-Bone implementation, and no automatic group-to-bone mapping yet.
- Static allocation limits, <=2GiB files, numeric Q16 range and stdio-library allocation caveats from Phase06 remain unchanged.

## Next targets

- Dedicated early 2.0x reader for the genuine 2.01/2.02 source-bundled files.
- Add bounded streaming Gzip/Zstd decoder or a clearly separate conversion prepass that preserves the no-heap constraint.
- Obtain real native Blender 4.5 and 5.x saved scenes (not older assets included with the source tarballs).
- Validate `MFaceInt`, TFace material/texture references, modern `CustomData` layer semantics, byte order and large-header edge cases.
- Improve performance for very large meshes and implement selected evaluated transforms/weights/animation.

This phase carries **only** new C89 codec code derived independently from the file-format information. Consulted Blender source remains under its upstream license. Previous Phase01–06 project files are retained.
